note: Acceptance conditions for the bounded technical-diligence release. An item is met only when it carries evidence that resolves: a test that exists, an artefact that exists, or a command that runs to its expected exit code. Prose is not evidence. tools/check_release_checklist.py enforces this on the merge path to main.

items.name: Freeze mechanism
items.condition: Nothing reaches main until the relevant condition passes, evidenced by a test, tool output or artefact.

items.name: Execution accounting
items.condition: A failed or unassessed execution cannot resemble a clean assessment, in stdout, exit code, summary counters or certificate.

items.name: Configuration identity
items.condition: Changing a file or environment setting mid-run cannot silently change what the run claims it enforced. Signing cannot describe a configuration other than the one that executed.

items.name: Evidence correctness
items.condition: The documented verification procedure rejects a row whose stated decision has been altered, and every pre-v4 archive still verifies under its own contract. An inconsistent run cannot receive a certificate asserting a conclusive pass.

items.name: Verification consolidation
items.condition: The normal evaluator procedure rejects changed, missing, mismatched and incomplete evidence without the evaluator needing to know which extra command closes which gap.

items.name: Key custody
items.condition: The question 'what happens if the signing key leaks' has a documented, tested answer.

items.name: Legitimate workload
items.condition: Results published with failures, exclusions and denominators. No rate published without its sampling method.

items.name: Reference demonstration
items.condition: All supported failure paths produce zero downstream calls; approved calls preserve the evaluated content. Another engineer reproduces it unaided.

items.name: Claims register
items.condition: Each public technical claim remains true when the reader examines the failures.
